newsitem.title: UK: Saatchi & Saatchi says UK army ads win recruits.
newsitem.headline: Saatchi & Saatchi says UK army ads win recruits.

text.p: An advertising campaign launched by the British army to attract enlistment has helped bring in new recruits, Saatchi & Saatchi, the agency that created the campaign, said on Monday.
Saatchi & Saatchi Advertising, which is owned by Cordiant Plc, said the campaign included a Website -- located at http://www.army.mod.uk -- and press, radio, television and poster advertising.
The advertising agency said the campaign helped reverse an eight-year decline in the number of recruitment enquiries received by the army, with a 34 percent increase in the last year.

"Enlistments are also now running at a year-on-year increase of 38 percent, meaning that the army's annual recruitment target of 15,100 soldiers will be within reach for the first time in four years," Saatchi & Saatchi said.
The ad agency, whose holding company got rid of founder Maurice Saatchi in December 1994 over a shareholder revolt, won a "gold award" for best poster from Campaign magazine.
